name: nora
description: Operate your self-hosted Nora agent fleet from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to a Nora control plane you operate. Deploy and control OpenClaw or Hermes agents, inspect fleet health, and read metrics, events, and cost through Nora's workspace-scoped API.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents accessible to the configured Nora workspace.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get live status and runtime details for one agent.

tools.name: get_agent_stats
tools.description: Get real-time resource and execution statistics for one agent.

tools.name: get_agent_versions
tools.description: List an agent's configuration version history.

tools.name: deploy_agent
tools.description: Provision and deploy a new OpenClaw or Hermes agent.

tools.name: stop_agent
tools.description: Stop an agent while preserving its state.

tools.name: restart_agent
tools.description: Restart a running agent in place.

tools.name: redeploy_agent
tools.description: Re-provision an agent with its current configuration.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Permanently delete an agent when destructive tools are explicitly enabled.

tools.name: get_platform_metrics
tools.description: Get workspace fleet counts and provisioning queue metrics.

tools.name: list_monitoring_events
tools.description: List recent agent and platform monitoring events.

tools.name: get_agent_metrics
tools.description: Get time-series usage metrics for one agent.

tools.name: get_agent_metrics_summary
tools.description: Get aggregated usage metrics for one agent.

tools.name: get_agent_cost
tools.description: Get token and USD cost roll-ups for one agent.

api_url.title: Nora URL
api_url.description: The public base URL of your Nora deployment, for example https://nora.example.com.

api_key.title: Nora API key
api_key.description: A workspace API key created in Nora under Workspace -> API Keys.

allow_destructive.title: Enable permanent deletion
allow_destructive.description: Expose delete_agent. Leave disabled unless you want Claude to be able to permanently delete agents.
